title: Carry givenAtEpochMillis into PendingDoseConfirmation
description: PendingDoseConfirmation now requires a givenAtEpochMillis field (task-013) -- this is the constructor call built when logDose reports NeedsConfirmation, so it must supply the time the user originally picked.
acceptance_criteria: The existing doseAmount, argument is unchanged
